projects.title: CyRisk Insight Engine
projects.shortDescription: Cybersecurity backend platform for large-scale threat intelligence analysis
projects.description: Built backend microservices and data-processing flows for a cyber-risk rating and vendor-risk-management platform — scanning a company's internet-facing footprint and correlating findings against vulnerability/threat-intel databases to produce a security rating.

architecture.infrastructure: Django/DRF core (API server, SQS-consumer worker, PDF renderer) + FastAPI partner gateway and scoring service, on Docker Swarm/EC2, Terraform-provisioned

impact.performance: ~30% API response-time improvement on Elasticsearch-backed queries
impact.auth: Custom auth backend with brute-force lockout, JWT + TOTP 2FA
impact.integration: Live partner integration via OAuth2 client-credentials against AWS Cognito

projects.context: A cyber-insurance-focused risk-rating SaaS platform needed scalable backend services for search-heavy threat intelligence data and event-driven updates.
design_decisions: Used Redis Pub/Sub for low-latency backend updates
Used Elasticsearch for search-heavy intelligence queries
Split responsibilities between a Django core platform and FastAPI microservices
Focused on measurable backend performance improvements

projects.title: Mevrik Digital Customer Experience Platform
projects.shortDescription: Backend platform for AI-driven customer care and SaaS onboarding
projects.description: Developed backend services for an omnichannel customer engagement platform — bringing email, social, live chat, and chatbot conversations into one system with multi-tenant routing to human agents.

architecture.infrastructure: Dockerized Django/DRF services with PostgreSQL + MySQL (legacy email schema) and Redis
architecture.messaging: Celery + Redis broker (Celery Beat scheduling, Flower monitoring) for background jobs; a third-party HTTP-based push service for real-time delivery (not WebSockets)

impact.realtime: Real-time delivery via a third-party hosted pub/sub push service

projects.context: The platform needed reliable backend services for digital customer care, async processing, and real-time interaction across a multi-tenant "Apps → Channels → Workgroups → Users" model.
design_decisions: Used FastAPI where lightweight service APIs were needed
Used Celery with Beat scheduling for asynchronous workflows and task execution
Used a third-party HTTP-based push service rather than WebSockets for real-time delivery
Kept deployment consistent with Dockerized services

projects.title: Event-Driven Data Pipeline
projects.shortDescription: Backend data pipeline built around Redis Pub/Sub and FastAPI services
projects.description: Implemented event-driven backend processing flows using Redis Pub/Sub, FastAPI, and Elasticsearch to support near real-time data movement and search.

architecture.messaging: Redis Pub/Sub for low-latency event distribution

impact.latency: Reduced processing latency through event-driven flows

projects.context: The system needed a practical event-driven approach for moving backend data between services with low latency.
design_decisions: Used Redis Pub/Sub for lightweight event fan-out
Separated ingestion and processing concerns
Used Elasticsearch for search-oriented access patterns
Focused on operational simplicity over unnecessary complexity

projects.title: Mayer Hashi - Maternal Health Platform
projects.shortDescription: Healthcare backend APIs supporting maternal health tracking and doctor interactions
projects.description: Built backend APIs for a maternal health application with appointment, reporting, and health-tracking workflows, deployed on AWS EC2 and RDS.

architecture.scale: Health tracking and doctor consultation workflows
architecture.infrastructure: Django REST, Flutter, AWS EC2, AWS RDS

impact.deployment: Deployed on AWS EC2 and RDS

projects.context: The product needed backend APIs for a healthcare application focused on maternal health tracking and doctor interaction.
design_decisions: Used Django REST for structured healthcare APIs
Modeled relational healthcare data in PostgreSQL
Designed the schema so appointments, medical reports, and nutrition tracking could be queried independently without duplicating patient data across tables
Used AWS EC2 and RDS for deployment
Focused on practical business workflows and backend reliability

projects.title: B-DOPS - Dengue Outbreak Prevention Surveillance
projects.shortDescription: Mobile-first public health platform for citizen-reported dengue breeding-site surveillance
projects.description: Led development of a public health platform where citizens photograph and geo-tag suspected mosquito breeding sites; an automated visual check flags likely larvae, and credible reports route to health authorities for review and field-staff dispatch.

architecture.scale: Citizen-reported case surveillance with authority review and field dispatch
architecture.infrastructure: Django REST + Channels (ASGI) backend, Flutter mobile client, PostgreSQL
architecture.messaging: Django Channels for real-time citizen-to-specialist chat

impact.detection: OpenCV-based automated larvae detection as a triage aid for citizen-submitted reports
impact.realtime: Real-time in-app chat between citizens and medical specialists
impact.workflow: End-to-end pipeline from citizen photo/GPS report to authority review and field-staff dispatch
impact.publichealth: Public warning-zone mapping driven by a confirmed-patient registry

projects.context: Public health authorities needed a way to crowdsource mosquito breeding-site reports and route credible cases to field staff faster than manual reporting allowed.
design_decisions: Used a classical OpenCV Haar-cascade classifier for fast, explainable larvae triage rather than a heavier trained model
Built real-time specialist chat on Django Channels alongside the existing synchronous DRF API
Modeled case status as independent solved/approved flags to reflect that field resolution and authority approval happen on separate timelines
Used Stripe Checkout for donations, backed by a ledger table for tracking

projects.title: Ledgerly — SaaS Accounting & Finance Platform
projects.shortDescription: Multi-tenant SaaS accounting platform with a visual IAM access-control studio
projects.description: A full multi-tenant SaaS accounting/finance platform — chart of accounts, journal entries, invoicing, payables, bank reconciliation, AR/AP aging, subscription billing, and a visual IAM Studio for managing roles and permissions without hand-editing JSON.

architecture.scale: Deny-first IAM authorization with per-workspace isolation
architecture.infrastructure: Go/Gin API + GORM/PostgreSQL backend, React/Vite SPA, Redis for caching and background jobs, Docker Compose deployment

impact.iam: Visual IAM Studio with guided permission builders and server-side impact preview before high-risk changes
impact.billing: Stripe Checkout + customer portal with HMAC-verified, replay-protected webhook handling
impact.observability: Liveness/readiness/metrics endpoints with structured JSON logs correlated by request/user/workspace IDs
impact.finance: Full accounting core — chart of accounts, journal entries, invoicing, bill payments, bank reconciliation, AR/AP aging reports

projects.context: Built solo, with AI-assisted development throughout, to explore a production-grade multi-tenant SaaS end to end — from double-entry accounting fundamentals to IAM and billing infrastructure most side projects skip.
design_decisions: Built a deny-first authorization middleware with a full permission catalog and audit logging on every role/policy mutation
Added IAM Studio, a visual access-control builder with impact preview, instead of requiring raw JSON policy edits
Hardened Stripe webhooks with shared-token plus HMAC signature validation, replay protection, and idempotency
Exposed /healthz, /readyz, and /metricsz endpoints with structured JSON logs for production observability

projects.title: Geographic Business Intelligence Platform
projects.shortDescription: Map-based business intelligence tool for visualizing regional demographic and economic data
projects.description: Built backend services for an interactive, map-based business-intelligence tool visualizing regional demographic and economic data, with region comparison and cross-metric scatter analysis.

architecture.infrastructure: Django REST + PostgreSQL/PostGIS across a reference-data schema and a client-ledger schema, plus a dynamic dataset registry
architecture.messaging: ThreadPoolExecutor for I/O-bound multi-database queries, multiprocessing for CPU-bound heat-map bucketing

impact.flexibility: Dynamic dataset registry allowing new datasets to be plugged in without code changes
impact.performance: Parallelized I/O-bound multi-table queries and CPU-bound heat-map mesh bucketing
impact.precision: Used the region's official geodetic datum for accurate coordinate handling instead of standard WGS84
impact.reconciliation: Reconciled two parallel industry-code vocabularies to enable cross-metric comparison

projects.context: Business users needed to compare regions and cross-plot demographic/economic metrics on a map without direct database access to the underlying datasets.
design_decisions: Built a dynamic dataset registry so new datasets could be plugged in without code changes
Used ThreadPoolExecutor for I/O-bound multi-database queries and multiprocessing for CPU-bound heat-map bucketing
Reconciled two parallel industry-code vocabularies to enable cross-metric comparison
Used the region's official geodetic datum for accurate coordinate handling instead of standard WGS84

aiProjects.title: IR Tool (RAG Pipeline)
aiProjects.shortDescription: AI workflow converting media into structured business content
aiProjects.description: Built an AI workflow using LangChain, Azure OpenAI, Azure Speech-to-Text, and Cosmos DB to convert media into structured business content.

architecture.infrastructure: Azure Cognitive Services and Cosmos DB

impact.processing: Audio and video to structured output

aiProjects.context: The workflow was designed to help business teams extract useful structured output from media inputs more quickly.
design_decisions: Used speech-to-text before retrieval and generation steps
Used RAG to keep knowledge updates flexible
Used Azure services for a unified AI workflow
Focused on practical output quality and workflow automation
